blocks.tamil_translation: I have no (sufficient) knowledge; while I call you to the All-Mighty (over all things), the Most Forgiving. Without any doubt, that to which you call me (to worship) - it has no (right) to be called upon (as a god) in this world or in the Hereafter; and surely our return is to Allah alone - and surely those who transgress the limits, they are the people of the Fire. So you will soon remember what I say to you; I entrust my affair to Allah; surely Allah is All-Seeing of (His) servants” (he also said).So Allah protected him from the evils of the plots they made; and an evil punishment encompassed the people of Fir'awn.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يبُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلوةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلي مَآ أَصَابَكَ ؕ إِنَّ ذلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ اْلأُمُورِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O my dear son, establish Salah! Enjoin good! Forbid (people) from evil! Be patient over the hardship that befalls you (through this)! Surely this is among the matters of firm resolve.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّة ٌ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمَانِ لا اللهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَاباً شَدِيدًا ؕ قَالُوا مَعْذِرَةً إِليَ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ ۞ فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ أَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ وَأَخَذْنَا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا بِعَذَابٍ م بَئِيسٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ۞).
